rights_evidence: The exact object page permits copying/modifying/distributing without permission and links CMA Open Access. Its public API identifies this accession’s share_license_status as CC0 and supplies the exact web image URL; CMA’s Open Access page explains that CC0 applies to designated public-domain artwork images.
claim_scope: A documented Qing semi-formal court robe type with clear field, border, cuff and hem hierarchy. A complementary textile branch to the ceramic vase; not proof of a particular ruler’s use or a universal imperial palette.
limits: The museum catalog dates this robe late 1700s and identifies the Jiaqing period (1796–1820); preserve that wording rather than invent an exact year. Its description associates this type with the emperor’s semi-official court meetings, but does not document this individual robe’s personal use by a named ruler. One laid-flat front view does not show the back, full three-dimensional fit or microscopic stitch construction. Motif meanings, silk/thread materials and rank/use conventions are source statements, not inferred solely from yellow, dragons or visual detail. This is a different accession from the removed Met 45.18 twelve-symbol robe; do not carry over its date, title or symbol count.
observable_features: The complete laid-flat garment is isolated against a neutral pale background, with both extended sleeves, cuffs and hem visible in color.
Dense dragons and cloud-like scrolls occupy the central body and shoulders, while long gold-colored outer sleeve fields are relatively plain.
A dark patterned border follows the collar and asymmetrical front closure, separating that edge from the main motif field.
Dark decorated cuffs form distinct sleeve-end zones; cresting wave-like bands and a wide multicolored diagonal-striped hem create separate lower registers.

association_evidence.supports: The exact accession is catalogued as Semi-formal Court Robe (Jifu), late 1700s, Jiaqing period, in silk satin with silk/metal-thread embroidery. The description explains the robe type’s imperial semi-official court use and the dragons/clouds/waves/rocks program; it does not identify an individual wearer or a precise manufacture year.
The public museum API for accession 1983.32 identifies this exact title and web image URL, and states share_license_status CC0.
The museum’s policy makes designated public-domain artwork images available under CC0; the exact object/API designation establishes that this selected image is included.
